=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Finalize tracking-issue lineage only from a verified orchestrator completion PR and its expected target branch, not from arbitrary linked PRs." (Issue #5619 audit recommendation; PR title and changelog.d/5619-tracking-lineage-completion-pr-only.md:3 "Only an orchestrator project's completion PR can now mark its tracking issue's AI-memory lineage as finished.")
  Expected change site: The positive path of the new completion-PR gate at `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:585-601`, reachable only when `ISSUE_NUMBERS` contains the tracking issue `<T>` (the loop's tracking-issue branch is only entered for issues in `ISSUE_NUMBERS`, populated at lines 373-426).
  Evidence of absence: The orchestrator's completion PR body built by `ensure_eager_final_pr` is `Squash merge of orchestrator project #${TRACKING_NUM}.\n\n...\n\nRefs #${TRACKING_NUM}` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8063-8067`). `Refs` is NOT one of the closing keywords accepted by `extract_repo_scoped_issue_refs_from_text` (`scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1662-1677`); the regex at line 1674 only matches `(close|closes|closed|fix|fixes|fixed|resolve|resolves|resolved)` followed by `#N`, plus full repo-scoped URLs/paths. The comment block at `scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1654-1656` explicitly REJECTS bare `issue #12` / `issues/12` mentions — and `Refs #N` falls in the same family. With no closing keyword in the body, `closingIssuesReferences` (`.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:366-374`) returns empty. The body/title fallback at lines 388-411 also returns empty because the body has no URL path matching `<repo>/issues/<N>` and no closing keyword. The head is `orchestrator/project-<T>`, so the `BRANCH_ISSUE_NUMBER` regex at line 414 (`^ai/issue-([0-9]+)...`) does not match. `ISSUE_NUMBERS` ends up empty, the step hits the "No linked issues found for PR #..." branch at line 424, and `exit 0` fires at line 426 before reaching the new completion-PR gate at line 590-593. The test `test_tracking_issue_completion_pr_finalizes_lineage` (`tests/test_issue_pr_status_target_branch_gate.py:698-713`) passes a body containing `https://github.com/{REPOSITORY}/issues/5` (line 695, `COMPLETION_PR_BODY`), so the body/title fallback DOES discover issue #5 in the test — but this body shape is not what `ensure_eager_final_pr` produces. The Copilot review comment (id 4151000719, file `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`, line 593) identifies the same chain. Net effect: arbitrary linked PRs that legitimately use `Fixes #<T>` are correctly rejected by the new gate, and the orchestrator-generated completion PR is also rejected because the tracking issue never enters the loop. Tracking-issue lineage is therefore essentially never finalized as `merged`; the security audit's stated impact (`scripts/memory_maintenance_extract_learnings.py:128` permanently excludes the project from learnings extraction) is replaced by the opposite — every orchestrator project is permanently excluded — and the changelog's "What this means for operators" paragraph (`changelog.d/5619-tracking-lineage-completion-pr-only.md:14`) already concedes this with "tracking-issue lineage is usually left unfinalized". The plan records this as AD-4 "Picked: A — no" (`docs/completed/issue-5619-tracking-lineage-completion-pr-only-plan.md:107`) and as the "ACCEPTED" risk on lines 86-87, deliberately leaving the positive path unwired so the #1469 regression guard (`extract_repo_scoped_issue_refs_from_text`'s rejection of bare `Refs`/`issue #N` mentions) does not have to be relaxed. Either the completion-PR producer must emit an accepted non-closing repo-scoped link (so the body/title fallback picks it up without re-opening the #1469 surface), or the gate must derive the tracking issue from the verified `orchestrator/project-<T>` head ref (without feeding it into the label/close loop, per the Copilot suggestion) — both of which would also unblock the test gap.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
